name: experience-learning-effectiveness
title: Experience Layer 3.4: learning_effectiveness — predictive-value metric + ON/OFF RCT readout
description: Add a read-only learning_effectiveness CLI that reports two layers of evidence for whether accumulated experience helps: (1) FAST signal — per-story hint predictive value, computed retrodictively over findings + signatureTags in temporal order (of the findings whose signature was known from PRIOR stories, how many would have been pre-warned = recall; of the would-have-hinted signatures, how many matched a real finding = precision), trended over story windows; and (2) LONG-GAME — an ON vs OFF arm comparison (from the experience_hint_surfaced hintMode events that 3.3 records) of a recurrence-style outcome, reporting N per arm and an explicit 'not yet significant' until power is reached. Strictly read-only and advisory: writes nothing, files no findings, touches no gate. Running it after the 3.5 backfill (real signatures) is the 're-run learning curve' evidence step.
